about: The factory presets of the reverb of the Audio Unit (Effect Chains/Reverb/Factory: `params` their plain params, the others at their defaults; kParamType none: the first type, Plate) in its effect rack, rendered and measured as reverb.json (its stand: the noise oscillator plays samples of ours one-shot at 44.1 kHz, a tone of 25 Hz at 1e-4 under each). The impulse all wet (Wet 100): rt60, energy, first, echo, levels and side as in reverb.json; octaves (dB, the energy of each octave of `octaves` of the response against that of the dry impulse); density [s, the share of the samples of 20 ms over their standard deviation against that of a noise]. gains: [the gain of the dry signal, of the wet one, the rest in dB] of its render at its own Wet as the sum of those at Wet 0 and 100. scene: the chord of reverb.json through it at its own Wet, the windows of reverb.json at `sceneTimes`; dry: the same of the empty rack. scripts/renders/run.mjs --only=reverb-presets
